method: Actual view_image inspection of all seven unique final PNG files; no additional browser controller attached.

images.observation: 完整近景、凸窗和退台可见，模型在操作栏之外，未裁边。
远景简化框格但保持体量、凸窗与顶部退台。
390像素手机页显示完整模型，控制与下载区域可用，无横向溢出。
主图选中华懋，主楼完整落在界面空区，东侧独立灰楼可见，未见旧41.6米水平细框。
北侧双翼、中间及两侧凹部明确，中央凹口可见地面，无旧高屋顶填入；东侧独立低楼在画面左侧完整保留。峻岭在画外，不作为该图像素声明。
390像素主图中模型、顶部退台和灯牌完整显示；名称自动换行，卡片与导航避开主体，东侧灰楼仍可见。
320像素全城场景74个编号灯牌全部可辨，标签无相互遮挡并避开底部卡片与控件；截图为点选前的大新控制对象，随后原生触控切至华懋见browser.json。

recovery_scope: Original five captures plus one mobile and one beacon continuation in the same Chrome. Two actual QA waiting-budget failures are retained in browser.json; production input bytes were unchanged, and source/queue/layout stabilization was never waived.
limitations: These images show the declared exterior and retained eastern neighboring geometry, not a surveyed reconstruction. Grosvenor is outside the northern context image; its preservation is supported by source identity and geometry checks, not claimed as a visible pixel in that image. Roof and hidden-side details remain estimated.
